data.action: 披素白羽衣穿行灯会回眸
data.description: 【令 · 大炎灯会】上元之夜，大炎城的长街上万盏灯笼如星河倒悬。令披着素白羽衣穿行在人潮之间，大袖随风轻摆，羽衣上的瑞兽绣纹在灯火下流转。她伸手接住一瓣飘落的烟火纸屑，含笑回眸——「人间烟火，最是动人。博士，陪我把这条街走完可好？」
data.lighting: warm festival lantern glow, colorful fireworks bokeh, golden street light
data.promptProse: Walking through the Yan capital's Lantern Festival, Ling turns back smiling in her white feathered robe, lifting a hand to catch a falling scrap from the fireworks. The medium view follows the lantern-lined street through the crowd toward layered rooftops. Golden lantern light reveals the auspicious embroidery along her moving sleeves; distant fireworks briefly color the feather edges and upper roofs.
data.title: 令 · 大炎灯会
